newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ First gets Treasury, RBNZ briefings.
newsitem.headline: NZ First gets Treasury, RBNZ briefings.

text.p: The New Zealand First party said its negotiating team for coalition-building talks had been briefed on Wednesday by Treasury and Reserve Bank officials.
Leader Winston Peters said the briefings were "invaluable in ensuring the negotiating team was fully informed on the current state of the economy and government accounts".
He added: "New Zealand First will not be making any policy commitments during coalition negotiations unless we are convinced they can be afforded."
He said NZ First would have the help of private sector economic analysts to offer advice on the economic implications of policy proposals.
NZ First holds the balance of power after Saturday's general election and says it will negotiate with the conservative National Party and the Labour Party.
